Here is what I'm seeing:

- The config loader crashes on startup
- Error occurs in parseIntEnv
- Only happens in production

internal/config/loader.go
package config

import (
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

type Config struct {
	Port int
	Host string
}

func Load() *Config {
	return &Config{
		Port: parseIntEnv("PORT", 8080),
		Host: os.Getenv("HOST"),
	}
}

func parseIntEnv(key string, fallback int) int {
	v := os.Getenv(key)
	if v == "" {
		return fallback
	}
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
	if err != nil {
		return fallback
	}
	return n
}

Does Load() look thread-safe to you?
